messages.content: Return JSON containing only compact SWI-Prolog plunit source in content. Import ../extension/mattermost_bridge.pl and test the declared public predicates without network or credentials. Include authorized stable event mapping, duplicate suppression, edited post distinction, unauthorized channel/user before payload construction, idempotent outbound request, malformed/send-failure-shaped effect rejection, reconnect and cursor resume, and panic denial. Tests must be deterministic and under 180 lines; do not redefine the bridge.
